Question 2
?

Which of the following gives the length of the curve defined by the parametric equations x=3t3+5,y=t2−5t from t=−1 to t=2 ?

a
∫−1281t4+4t2−20t+25dt
b
∫−129t4+4t2−20t+5dt
c
2∫−129t4+t2−5t+6dt
d
3∫−1227t4+4t2−t+6dt

∫−1285t4−20t+25dt
